column2: SANSOS lexicon — GENERATED by `cargo run -p lexgen`. Edit spec/lexicon.src.tsv.
One word, one sense (doc 01 §4 rule 5). Every diagnostic, every Sankriti
prompt and every document resolves its terms through this file, so a term
that means two things here means two things everywhere.
slp1 is generated by the sanskrit-text encoder (task A-019) and round-trips
back to the Devanagari byte-for-byte; iast is derived from slp1.

column8: notes
T1's inequality operator, frozen from the corpus by ADR-0026. Replaces doc 15's proposed `विषमम्`, which no source writes.
ADR-0028: also T1's multiplication operator (`mul_op`). Doc 15's proposed `गुण` is retired — unwritten by any source.
आ+√गम् (coming in); the fence domain RISC-V spells `i` (B-045)
√पठ् (to read) + अनम्; the fence domain RISC-V spells `r` (B-045)
√लिख् (to write) + अनम्; the fence domain RISC-V spells `w` (B-045)

ADR-0029: T1's `type_name`. Spelled `पाठः` until 2026-08-31; the corpus writes the stem 26 to 2 in the one type position `binding` freezes, and doc 01 §4 rule 5 forbids carrying both words for this one sense.
T1’s greater-or-equal, frozen from the corpus by ADR-0037; vakyavibhaga.t1:3163 has written it since 2026-08-29. Replaces doc 15’s proposed `अधिकसमम्`, which no source writes.

T0 only. T1 spells division `विभाजनम्` (ADR-0026), which is the word its corpus writes; doc 15's proposed `भाग` is retired. The two tiers differ here and ADR-0028 says so rather than respelling a frozen T0 mnemonic.
ADR-0028: also T1's addition operator (`add_op`). Doc 15 proposed `अधि` for the T1 sense; no source writes it and ADR-0026 froze this word from the corpus, so the two tiers spell addition alike.
Frozen from the corpus by ADR-0026. T0's divide mnemonic is `भागः`; doc 15's proposed `भाग` is retired.
ADR-0028: also T1's subtraction operator (`add_op`). Doc 15's proposed `ऊन` is retired — unwritten by any source.

T0 rem, and since ADR-0037 T1’s modulo operator — encode.t1:647, :676 write it between two operands. Replaces doc 15’s proposed `शेष`, which no source writes. The corpus writes `शेषम्` far more often, but every one of those is a local variable holding a remainder, not the operator.
उपरि (upper) + भारः (load); the immediate lands in the high bits
उपरि (upper) + गुणनम्; the high half of a product, as उपरिभारः is the high half of an immediate
भिन्न + समम् (doc 15's equality operator)
भिन्न + न्यूनम् (doc 15's less-than)
भिन्न + अ (privative) + अधिकम् (doc 15's greater-than); not-greater is <=, the negation ADR-0008 uses for branches. The अ+अ join is savarṇa-dīrgha (6.1.101)
भिन्न + गुण + वियोगः, beside भिन्नगुणयोगः
ऋण (ADR-0009's negative) + भिन्नगुणयोगः
ऋण + भिन्नगुणवियोगः
व्यत्यय (the T0 name for bitwise not) + चिह्नारोपणम्
वैषम्यम् (the T0 name for xor) + चिह्नारोपणम्
नियन्त्रक + विनिमयः (exchange), as in परमाणुविनिमयः
नियन्त्रक + विकल्पः (the T0 name for or); setting a bit is or-ing it
नियन्त्रक + अप+√सृ (to remove) + अनम्; clearing is removal. The अ+अ join is savarṇa-dīrgha
मिश्र (mixed) + उपरिगुणनम्; one operand signed and one not, which is why it needs its own name
अचिह्न (ADR-0006) + उपरिगुणनम्; the अ+उ join is guṇa (6.1.87), a rule sandhi.rs defers
स्थान (place) + सापेक्ष (relative) + योगः (add); pc-relative
स + चिह्न (sign) + दक्षिणसरणम्; preserves the sign bit, unlike दक्षिणसरणम्
अ (privative) + चिह्न (sign) + आहारः; zero-extends where आहारः sign-extends. Formed by the same savarṇa-dīrgha join (अ + आ -> आ) that sandhi.rs declines to compute (B-051)
वि+√श्लिष् (to take apart) + अनम्; doc 17's counterpart to साधनम् (B-013)
सम (from समम्, doc 15's equality operator) + लङ्घनम्
विषम + लङ्घनम्. The T0 spelling predates ADR-0026 and is frozen by spec/conformance-rvc-t0.tsv; T1's inequality operator is `असमम्` (ADR-0028), not the retired `विषमम्` this name was derived from.
न्यून (from न्यूनम्, doc 15's less-than) + लङ्घनम्
अ (privative) + न्यून + लङ्घनम्; not-less is >=, the same negation ADR-0006 uses
अचिह्न (ADR-0006) + न्यून + लङ्घनम्
अचिह्न + अन्यून + लङ्घनम्; the अ+अ join is savarṇa-dīrgha (6.1.101), the rule sandhi.rs declines to compute (B-051)
अ (privative) + चिह्न (sign) + न्यूनम्; ADR-0006 — the unsigned sibling of न्यूनम्
अ (privative) + चिह्न (sign) + भागः; ADR-0006 — the unsigned sibling of भागः
अ (privative) + चिह्न (sign) + शेषः; ADR-0006 — the unsigned sibling of शेषः
अ (privative) + चिह्न (sign) + परमाणुपरमम्; ADR-0006 — the unsigned sibling of परमाणुपरमम्
अ (privative) + चिह्न (sign) + परमाणुन्यूनतमम्; ADR-0006 — the unsigned sibling of परमाणुन्यूनतमम्
सापेक्ष (relative) + लङ्घनम् (jump); target comes from a register
अन्वेषण (investigation, cf अन्वेषकः debugger) + विरामः (halt); विरामः alone is `halt` and a breakpoint is not one
परमाणु (atomic) + योगः
परमाणु + युक्तम्
परमाणु + विकल्पः
परमाणु + वैषम्यम्
परमाणु + परमम् (highest)
परमाणु + न्यूनतमम् (least)
भिन्न (float register) + आहारः
भिन्न + निधानम्
भिन्न + योगः
भिन्न + वियोगः
भिन्न + गुणनम्
भिन्न + भागः
भिन्न + गुणनम् + योगः; multiply and add as one rounding
भिन्न + परमम्
भिन्न + न्यूनतमम्
भिन्न + रूपान्तरम् (change of form)
चिह्न (sign) + आरोपणम् (placing upon)
भिन्न + तुलना
भिन्न + वर्गः (class); वर्ग is already `square, class`
भिन्न + संचारः
नियन्त्रक (controlling) + कोष्ठ (register)
आदेश (instruction) + बन्धः (binding); orders instruction fetch, not data
स्मृतिक्षेत्रम् (address space, doc 11) + बन्धः, the third of the pair स्मृतिबन्धः and आदेशबन्धः; orders updates to the page tables, which is neither data nor fetch
सम् + आ + √पद् -> समापनम् (bringing to an end); ADR-0016 call 0, and the call an application ends by rather than returning
आ + √लिख् + अनम् (writing upon); ADR-0016 call 1. Distinct from लेखनम्, which is the fence domain RISC-V spells `w`
ADR-0016 error code 0; the four failures are असमर्थितम्, अधिकाराभावः, रिक्तप्रवेशः and सीमातिक्रमः, all of which the lexicon already carried
चालन (causing to move / setting in motion); UI coinage for program execution (Sanskriti)

ADR-0018 — prosody's caesura, "the pause that divides a metrical line"; doc 17a §3.3 already names darshana's line breaker यतिः for the same concept. A VALUE in T1 and never an escape: inside उक्तम् … इति it is its own four akṣaras
ADR-0018 — वि+√वृ, an opening or interstice, the interval between two things; U+0020 as a value. अवकाशः, the obvious word, is taken by the linker's संरचना अवकाश (Slot) and अन्तरम् is already `delta`
